> *"Prefer the supplier with a current rate contract. A cheaper quotation from a new supplier does not by itself justify a change of supplier for a food-contact part."*

Since our 5-litre silicone gaskets (`GSK-SIL-05L`) are marked as food-contact items (`food_contact: true`), any supplier we purchase them from must have a valid food-grade certificate registered in Bahi first.
